line.speaker: right
line.text: [i]You approach Fred like you would a wild animal. He seems absorbed in his work, rummaging through a pile of cables.[/i]

line.speaker: left
line.text: Ah, mais bordel! Where the hell is that XT60?

line.speaker: right
line.text: He keeps looking, not noticing you arrived.

line.speaker: left
line.text: Ahhh, here it is! Now, the female one…

line.speaker: right
line.text: [i]You cough.[/i]

line.speaker: left
line.text: Ah, yes, sorry! Annabelle sent you, right?

line.speaker: right
line.text: Yes, she told me…

line.speaker: left
line.text: Yes, perfect because we need to set up the XT60 connections to jack up together the lights connection. There’s 6 light switches in parallel. Well, actually, they are on 3 different amps, so it’s not really in parallel, but I just say it because it works the same. In fact, if it was only on one, we would only have half the power, hahaha. Can you imagine Running 6 50W on one single alternator? This would be like.. Plugging two XP12’s in series without a commutator!

line.speaker: right
line.text: Hum, yes. So, about that help you need.

line.speaker: left
line.text: Yes, yes, bien sûr! So, I'll make it simple for you. There are 5 AP-54 jumpers connected to a single trenchline that runs from the jackswitch to the mic plugs. We just need to reroute the current switch so that we never run out of bandwidth. Got it?

line.speaker: right
line.text: Hum…

line.speaker: left
line.text: Okay. I’ll make it reeeeeeal simple for you.

line.speaker: right
line.text: [i]He just wants me to plug these cables together, right?[/i]

line.speaker: left
line.text: Thanks! That would have been a mess to do alone.

line.speaker: right
line.text: [i]He seems actually surprised that you managed to help him.[/i][i] He opens a can of soda, and takes a sip.[/i]

line.speaker: left
line.text: Ahh, nice. You want a sip? No? Anyways. Who are you with after this?

line.speaker: right
line.text: I have to help Sarah to quoicoubeh.

line.speaker: left
line.text: Ah, Sarah! Good luck with that.. Hopefully you wont get the full speech about why we do this and all that nonsense.

line.speaker: right
line.text: [i]You stay silent.[/i]

line.speaker: left
line.text: I mean…

line.speaker: left
line.text: It’s not that she’s wrong. I get what she means. But, like, definitely we don’t have the same priorities.

line.speaker: left
line.text: Like me, I do this because I like it, tu vois? I don’t really have an opinion. I show up, I do my job, I like it, I get paid. I don’t see what’s there to think about.

line.speaker: left
line.text: The boss, he can threaten me, I don't care so much. In the end i’ll find another place where I can work on lights, on sound, and it will be the same for me.

line.speaker: right
line.text: [i]You nod. He’s obviously the lone wolf type.[/i]

line.speaker: left
line.text: Sarah, she worries too much about this. She stirs stuff up. Me, I don’t make waves. And in the end I'm happier for it. I don’t know. Maybe I’m wrong. Whatever.

line.speaker: left
line.text: She is strong and resourceful, I'll give her that.

line.speaker: right
line.text: Do you feel that way with everyone you work with?

line.speaker: left
line.text: No. Annabelle, though, she’s cool. You know she was there in the 60s? the golden era?

line.speaker: right
line.text: Yes, I’ve heard that.

line.speaker: left
line.text: That was a cool time. No ressources, just plain technical know-how, passionate people connecting through music. I mean, I wasn’t there. But it sounds cool, doesn’t it?

line.speaker: right
line.text: Sure does!

line.speaker: right
line.text: [i]Not so lone wolf after all.[/i]

line.speaker: left
line.text: Anyways, you should probably get going. [i]Laughingly[/i]. You don’t want to get on Sarah’s bad side, like me!
